hero.seoDesc: Traditional Thai massage and relaxation massages in Galanta, Hody area. You can find us at Hody 1679, 924 01 Galanta.

usp1.title: Authentic Thai massage
usp1.desc: The salon is run by a certified Thai masseuse who attends to each client personally. Thanks to an individual approach, experience and emphasis on quality, you can enjoy an authentic Thai massage in a pleasant atmosphere and with maximum care.

usp2.title: Massage in the privacy of a quiet garden
usp2.desc: Enjoy a rest in a separate garden studio, which is set in a peaceful environment among family houses. Intimate atmosphere, silence and privacy create an ideal place for relaxation of body and mind.

usp3.title: Time reserved strictly for you
usp3.desc: In our private studio, we attend to each client individually and without rush. During the massage, you have space for real relaxation, privacy and care tailored to your needs.

s1.title: Traditional Thai massage
s1.desc: An authentic therapy combining acupressure, stretching and working with the body's energy pathways. Effectively removes muscle tension and blockages.

s2.title: Thai oil massage
s2.desc: A relaxing procedure using natural aromatic oils. Ideal for unwinding after a stressful day and harmonizing the mind.

s3.title: Foot reflexology
s3.desc: Stimulation of acupressure points on the feet, which brings relief not only to the legs, but also has a positive effect on the whole body.

s4.title: Back and neck massage
s4.desc: Focused on the most overloaded parts of the body. Extremely helpful with pain from prolonged sitting and a stiff neck.

about.label: Our Story & Philosophy
about.p1: was created as a dream come true about a peaceful place where a person slows down for a while and treats himself to time just for himself. We lovingly created our cozy salon right in a quiet garden in Hody near Galanta — in a private design studio that offers peace, discretion and an atmosphere far from the hustle and bustle of the everyday world.
about.p2: Only certified Thai masseuse Kay takes care of your comfort and regeneration. Since she works independently and gives each client an individual approach, each procedure is personal, peaceful and tailored to your needs.
about.p3: During the massage, the whole studio is reserved just for you. No noise, no waiting, no anonymous environment of large salons. Only you, a peaceful atmosphere and a touch that helps your body and mind find balance again.
about.featureDesc: 100% natural ingredients that nourish your skin.
